# Third-party audio library (not shipping yet)

Library copies of CC0 packs. `src/systems/audio.ts` is still the procedural WebAudio bed; nothing here is loaded by the game. Promote selected cues into `public/assets/` + `assets.csv` before wiring them.

## Humble — Best of Leartes (not downloaded)

<https://www.humblebundle.com/software/best-leartes-gigantic-game-dev-assets-tools-megabundle-software>

Not free. Humble JSON on 2026-08-23: `is_free: false`, minimum **₺238.47** (~US$30). Unreal/Unity/Godot environment megapack; needs a Humble account + payment + Cosmos/Fab redeem. Do not buy without sahip saying so.

## Packs in this folder

Both Kenney, **CC0 1.0** (credit nice, not required). Original `License.txt` kept next to the files.

| Folder | Source | Why Lotophagoi |
|---|---|---|
| `kenney-interface-sounds/` | https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds | Title/Hub clicks, mute toggle, `pluck_*` for harvest |
| `kenney-rpg-audio/` | https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio | Foley: cloth (satchel), footsteps (sand), metal/wood (ship, helm) |

Do not use the RPG coin/knife cues as victory fanfares — `gdd-lotus-collection.md` §9.
